rules: validation/m6-f1-f2-limits.json, committed before any run and not changed after a result
run: spikes/m6_same_mac.sh start COMMIT f1f2, from the public repository, with an empty HOME, its own uv, Python and caches, no sudo and no setting changed

grades.why: No CUDA run took part, and neither original program ran

f1_mac_port.reference: A golden from the original on this CPU, not from CUDA

bf16.summary: ok: weights ok; ok: 586 pass, 0 fail, 0 unverified, 50 skipped, 285 chain drift

q8.summary: ok: weights ok; ok: 586 pass, 0 fail, 0 unverified, 50 skipped, 323 chain drift

f1_original_program.summary: The script failed on mps: ImportError: Using `bitsandbytes` 8-bit quantization requires bitsandbytes: `pip install -U bitsandbytes>=0.46.1`
f1_original_program.why: transformers 5.22.1 asks for the bitsandbytes distribution before it loads the model. mps-bitsandbytes 0.7.0 is another distribution, and it has no Linear8bitLt or Int8Params. The substitute does not give the API that this program needs
f1_original_program.not_reached: The program stopped before attention ran, so this run says nothing about mps-flash-attn. That package has no flash_attn_func or flash_attn_varlen_func

f2_mac_training.limit: The target images come from metalsplat itself, so this does not check the renderer against an independent one. Both attempts used seed 0, and held-out PSNR differed (42.67 dB, 43.49 dB), so the training on MPS does not repeat exactly. seconds covers the training loop only

f2_original_program.summary: The script failed on mps: AttributeError: module 'metalsplat' has no attribute 'rasterization'
f2_original_program.why: metalsplat has no rasterization, the function that a gsplat program calls

attempts.what: cumlx port --revision failed with exit 4 on each use, because the mlx_lm convert command line has no such flag. The wrong port was then not made, so that part was not_run. Fixed in 2279aea, with the rules unchanged. The original programs and the training gave the same result in both attempts, except for the PSNR above

not_shown: A port on another Mac, any comparison with CUDA for this run, and any run of the original programs to the end. The results stay in ~/cumlx-repro on this Mac
